name: GlzCheckbox
semanticRole: Represent an independent boolean or mixed-state choice that may be submitted or applied with a surrounding task.

material.rule: Checkboxes remain compact solid controls. Do not add decorative Glaze to the check box itself; a containing floating surface may provide material context.

input.keyboard: Space toggles the focused checkbox; tab navigation follows document order; mixed state resolves according to the owning domain rule.
input.focus: Visible focus surrounds the control or complete label row and is not hidden by the check glyph.
input.hover: Hover may strengthen boundary/state layer but is never required to discover label or state.
input.press: Press feedback is immediate and the whole associated label row is clickable where a label exists.
input.selection: Checked and indeterminate states use glyph/shape plus semantic state, not color alone.

accessibility.name: The visible associated label supplies the accessible name.
accessibility.state: Checked, unchecked, mixed/indeterminate, disabled, required where applicable, and invalid state are programmatically exposed.
accessibility.value: Boolean or mixed checked state is exposed through native or ARIA checkbox semantics.
accessibility.keyboard: Space toggles; focus order and label activation match platform conventions.
accessibility.focus: Focus remains visibly distinct from checked/selected state.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Invalid grouped choices associate the explanatory error with the group/control.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Check drawing becomes a direct state swap or 120–160ms non-bouncy transition.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: No functional change is required because the control is solid by default.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen boundary, glyph, and focus ring while preserving mixed-state distinction.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use native checkbox or platform system colors/marks where possible.
accessibility.largeText: Label reflows independently of the visual box; the full label row remains the target.

fallbacks.forcedColors: Native/platform checkbox appearance and semantic state.
fallbacks.performance: No advanced material dependency; preserve native semantic control first.

content.overflow: Labels wrap instead of clipping; grouped checkbox sets may stack or reflow at narrow widths.
content.localization: Labels, group legends, support text, and errors tolerate locale expansion without reducing the control hit target.
content.rtl: Control and label order mirror with locale direction; check/mixed glyph identity does not mirror.

criteria: Unchecked, checked, and indeterminate states remain instantly distinguishable.
The visible control stays compact while the interaction target remains comfortable.
Error and disabled treatments do not erase the current checked state.
Long labels remain aligned and readable at 200% text scale.
